description: This source file defines the CheckOutEvents class, which contains static methods for managing checkout processes, including validation, page navigation, order creation, and payment processing within an e-commerce platform built on the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CheckOutEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling various checkout-related events such as validation, order creation, payment processing, and navigation within the shopping cart checkout workflow.

methods.name: cartNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the shopping cart associated with the request is not empty.

methods.name: setCheckOutPages
methods.description: Manages the checkout page flow based on user input and cart state.

methods.name: determineInitialCheckOutPage
methods.description: Determines the first checkout page to display based on cart contents.

methods.name: setCheckOutError
methods.description: Retrieves the current checkout page in case of an error.

methods.name: setQuickCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Calculates tax and sets checkout options for a quick checkout process.

methods.name: setPartialCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Sets checkout options partially, used during incremental checkout.

methods.name: setCartShipToCustomerParty
methods.description: Sets the shipping address to the customer party ID.

methods.name: checkPaymentMethods
methods.description: Validates the selected payment methods for the current cart.

methods.name: getSelectedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves and processes payment methods selected by the user in the request.

methods.name: setCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Sets shipping, payment, and other checkout options based on request parameters.

methods.name: checkoutValidation
methods.description: Validates that the cart has the necessary information (payment and shipment) before proceeding.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates an order using the createOrder service, handling order finalization.

methods.name: calcTax
methods.description: Calculates tax for the shopping cart.

methods.name: explodeOrderItems
methods.description: Determines whether to explode order items based on store settings.

methods.name: checkShipmentNeeded
methods.description: Checks if shipment is needed based on cart items and store settings.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes payment for the current order, including payment authorization and failure handling.

methods.name: checkOrderDenylist
methods.description: Checks if the order is on a denylist, returning error or fail status.

methods.name: failedDenylistCheck
methods.description: Handles denial list check failure, potentially invalidating session.

methods.name: checkExternalCheckout
methods.description: Checks if external checkout (e.g., PayPal) is applicable.

methods.name: checkExternalPayment
methods.description: Checks and validates external payment options.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntry
methods.description: Handles final adjustments and validation before placing an order, depending on the mode.

methods.name: determineNextFinalizeStep
methods.description: Determines the next step in the checkout process after current actions.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryError
methods.description: Retrieves the error page or mode if finalization fails.

methods.name: determineBillingAccountAmount
methods.description: Determines the amount to charge on a billing account, considering available balance and user input.

methods.name: createReplacementOrder
methods.description: Creates a replacement order from an existing order, used in reorder or reship scenarios.
